messages.subject: Can I remove states from the pie chart?
messages.subject_clean: Can I remove states from the pie chart?
messages.body_plain:
Dear Dr Matzke,

Thanks for add me. I have been using this code segment to obtain the pie charts of 5 areas, that is, 16 states. However, that is a lot of division for circle graphs. Is it possible to eliminate some states that present a low percentage in the pie charts, in order to only keep the ones with the highest percentage?

plot_BioGeoBEARS_results(larrAArC, plotwhat = "pie", tipcex = 0, statecex = 0.9, plotsplits = F, plotlegend = FALSE, legend_cex = 0.5, titlecex = 0, splitcex = 0.8, cornercoords_loc = "C:/Users/URIEL/Documents/R/win-library/4.1/BioGeoBEARS/extdata/a_scripts/",
                         skiptree = T, tipboxes_TF = F, colors_list_for_states= colors_list_for_states)

Many thanks,

Sincerely,
Alexander.
